name: Payroll Cost sliced by Patient shows the message (P41)
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(CALCULATE([Payroll Cost], 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608, TREATAS({-1}, Patient[Patient Key])) = """Payroll Cost"" can't be analysed by ""Patient"""))

name: Payroll Cost sliced by an Encounters column shows the message (P41)

name: Payroll Cost sliced by two wrong tables lists both (P41)

name: Payroll Cost YoY Δ by Patient passes the message through the calculation group (P40, P41)
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(CALCULATE([Payroll Cost], 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608, TREATAS({-1}, Patient[Patient Key]), 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YoY Δ") = """Payroll Cost"" can't be analysed by ""Patient"""))

name: Revenue sliced by Patient stays a number, branch 1, 2026-08 (P41)
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Revenue], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608, Patient[Gender] = "Male"))
sql: select sum(c.revenue_amount) from gold.ssas_fact_charge_line as c inner join gold.ssas_dim_patient as p on p.patient_key = c.patient_key where c.branch_key = 1 and c.delivery_date_key >= 20260801 and c.delivery_date_key < 20260901 and p.gender = 'Male'
